title: 政府、備蓄石油の追加放出開始　国内消費20日分、全国10カ所
extracted_text: 政府は1日、石油の国家備蓄の追加放出を茨城県内の石油基地で始めたと明らかにした。全国の計10カ所で順次開始し、国内消費の約20日分に相当する580万キロリットルを市場に供給する。イラン攻撃開始後の3月に始めた第1弾の放出に続き、供給の安定を図る。 1日に作業が始まったのは茨城県神栖市の鹿島石油鹿島原油タンクヤードで、約20万キロリットルを放出する。2日には鹿児島県東串良町の志布志国家石油備蓄基地でも始める。 ENEOS（エネオス）と出光興産、コスモ石油、太陽石油の元売り4社に総額約5400億円で引き渡す。第1弾の放出では850万キロリットルをほぼ同額で引き渡しており、中東情勢の悪化を受けた原油価格の上昇により4割ほど値上がりすることになる。 政府は原油の代替調達も進めている。4月下旬には米国産を積んだタンカーが情勢悪化後では初めて到着。5月は前年実績の約6割を確保できるとし、足りない分を備蓄の放出で賄うと説明している。
translated_text: The government announced on the 1st that it has begun additional releases of national oil stockpiles at a petroleum base in Ibaraki Prefecture. Releases will be rolled out sequentially at 10 locations across the country, supplying 5.8 million kiloliters of oil to the market—equivalent to about 20 days of domestic consumption. This follows the first round of releases that began in March after the Iran attacks, and aims to ensure stable supply. Work began on the 1st at the Kashima Oil Kashima Crude Oil Tank Yard in Kashima City, Ibaraki Prefecture, releasing approximately 200,000 kiloliters. On the 2nd, releases will also begin at the Shibushi National Oil Stockpile Base in Higashikushino Town, Kagoshima Prefecture. The oil will be transferred to four wholesale companies—ENEOS, Idemitsu Kosan, Cosmo Oil, and Taiyo Oil—for a total of approximately 540 billion yen. In the first round of releases, 8.5 million kiloliters were transferred at roughly the same price, but due to rising crude oil prices following the deterioration of the Middle East situation, costs will increase by about 40%. The government is also working on securing alternative crude oil supplies. In late April, a tanker carrying US crude will arrive for the first time since the situation worsened. For May, the government says it can secure approximately 60% of the previous year's volume, with any shortfall to be covered by releasing stockpiles.
title_en: Government Begins Additional Release of Stockpiled Oil: 20 Days of Domestic Supply at 10 Sites Nationwide
